verdict.rationale: An identity verification service that processes biometric and document data with ML models could plausibly offer a training opt-out, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions model-training data use, opt-out controls, or data-usage restrictions. The Known Faces comparison against the account's own database is a fraud-detection feature, not a training control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
